The Future of PMM

Executive Summary — Pilot Program Results & H2 Engagement Plan

Prepared for Brenda Brown · September 2026 · Chris O'Hara

🎯 The Vision: Three Pillars of PMM Excellence

The Book of Work establishes product marketing as a strategic discipline at SAP. To bring it to life across ~500 PMMs, we've defined three pillars — each AI-enabled:

Pillar 01
Disciplined Operations
Execute with consistency — one set of playbooks, frameworks, and standards every PMM inherits.
Pillar 02
Connected Community
One culture, shared success — all-hands, AMAs, spotlights, and recognition.
Pillar 03
Continuous Learning
Real-time sandbox and Labs — hands-on sessions where PMMs apply AI tools to real work.
This Report: The Future of PMM pilot represents the first Labs cohort under Pillar 03 — validating the learning journey and AI Labs before scaling to all 500 PMMs.

What Learners Said

"I need to change my overall mindset of how to use AI from intern to co-worker."

"Understanding GEO — SEO does not ensure returns in AI results."

"How to structure PMM content so AI agents can parse it, quote it, and cite it accurately."

Key Finding: The curriculum successfully shifted mental models. Learners consistently cited the "AI as co-worker" framework as an actionable insight they're now applying.

📅 H2 Engagement Plan: From Vision to 500 PMMs

Move the whole org from aware to active to contributing — each phase makes the next one land.

REACH
Everyone hears it
All-hands, exec comms, community hub as front door
ACTIVATE
Many take part
Learning journey + Labs, AMAs, Spotlights, first playbooks
EMBED
It becomes the norm
Playbooks in daily work, champions in every LoB, recognition live

🚀 Next Steps

Immediate: Site Migration

Complete Migration Guide prepared — current architecture, database schema, SAP BTP equivalents, phase-by-phase plan. Ready to hand off to IT.

In Progress: SuccessFactors Learning

12-unit curriculum being adapted for SuccessFactors — formal tracking, integration with employee learning records, scalable delivery globally.

Phase 03 Vision: Embed

  • Learning — PMMs complete curriculum for foundational AI-era skills
  • Tools — AI agents assist with each of the 19 Book of Work areas
  • Guardrails — All AI-assisted work within approved guidelines
  • Measurement — Track engagement across all 500 PMMs

✅ Summary

The Future of PMM pilot achieved its objectives under Pillar 03: Continuous Learning:

  • Validated demand — 181 users registered, 53 provided feedback, NPS of 9.1
  • Proved the curriculum — 73% pass rate, 12 units mapped to Book of Work
  • Built the lab infrastructure — 16 AI labs covering all major BoW areas
  • Prepared for scale — Migration guide complete, SuccessFactors in progress

The pilot positions SAP to move from ACTIVATE to EMBED across all 500 PMMs — with playbooks, recognition, and measured adoption at every step.
